name: SQL: Select all indicValues of a given indicator
query:
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, sale_order_count, total_due, create_date
FROM CUSTOMER
WHERE sale_order_count > ?
  AND total_due > ?
ORDER BY create_date ASC;
